num.title: Numbering
num.description: How each document gets its number: the pattern, when the series starts again, whether it may have gaps, and what number comes next. A scheme that has issued numbers is never changed; you retire it and replace it, and numbers are never reused or renumbered.
num.company.label: Company
num.company.help: Schemes belong to a company. Document types of the whole organisation have one scheme for everyone.
num.denied: You may not see the numbering schemes.
num.loadError: The numbering schemes could not be loaded.
num.empty.body: No module has registered a numbered document yet.
num.types.title: Numbered documents
num.state.default: Standard pattern, set at first use
num.pick.body: Open a document type to see its scheme, its next number and its history.
num.scheme.title: Scheme of {name}
num.scheme.next.note.gapFree: Given when the document is posted; a number is never skipped.
num.scheme.next.note.gaps: A failed save can use up a number, so the next one may be one higher.
num.scheme.retired.title: Retired schemes
num.scheme.none: This document has no scheme for this company yet. The standard pattern {pattern} is set when the first number is needed; you can set your own now.
num.action.newBranch: Set a scheme for a branch
num.explain.used: This scheme has issued numbers, so it cannot be changed. Retire and replace starts a new scheme from today; the old numbers stay as they are and are never reused.
num.explain.fixed: A scheme that continues an earlier series keeps its reset rule, gap-free setting and starting number.
num.form.title.replace: Retire and replace the scheme of {name}
num.form.branch.help: A branch scheme prints the branch code, so its numbers never equal the company's.
num.form.pattern.help: Write the number as text with parts in curly braces, listed below the field. The running number is needed exactly once. Put a separator such as - or / after a company or branch code.
num.form.gapFree: Gap-free (numbers given when the document is posted)
num.form.gapFree.help: Turn on only where the law or the auditors need every number used. A gap-free series cannot be numbered when the document is saved.
num.form.example.none: Write a pattern to see an example.
num.form.example.long: This number would be longer than 40 characters.
num.form.warn.company: The company code {code} is printed in these numbers. If the company's code is renamed later, new numbers print the new code and numbers already issued keep the old one.
num.form.warn.branch: The branch code is printed in these numbers. If a branch's code is renamed later, new numbers print the new code and numbers already issued keep the old one.
num.form.error.start: The starting number must be a whole number from 1.
num.form.replace.failed: The old scheme was retired but the new one was refused ({reason}). The old pattern has been set again, so numbering carries on as before.
num.form.replace.stranded: The old scheme was retired and the new one could not be set. Numbering of this document is stopped until a scheme is set; set one now.
num.replaced: The scheme has been replaced. Numbers issued so far stay as they are.
num.retire.title: Retire the scheme?
num.retire.body: After this the document has no scheme until you set one. Numbers already issued stay as they are.
num.report.title: Void report: {pattern}
num.report.issued.none: No number issued in this range.
num.report.voids.none: No number has been voided in this range.
num.report.gapNote: A void number keeps its place in the series: it is listed here and never used again.
num.report.denied: You may not see the void report.
num.report.loadError: The void report could not be loaded.
num.report.rangeError: The start date must be on or before the end date.
num.token.seq: the running number, with at least N digits (N from 1 to 12), for example '{'seq:5'}'
